ideas.pitch: An open-source AI platform utilizing satellite imagery and low-cost sensor streams to predict hyperlocal pollution spikes and correlate them with localized respiratory illness admissions for municipal intervention.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world public-good challenge emphasizing open-source AI solutions under the Indo-Swiss Research Grant framework.
ideas.title: IndoSwiss Open-Source Air Quality & Public Health Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the Indo-Swiss Research Grant organizers' focus on open-source public health impact and rigorous research-backed validation.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent leveraging multilingual LLMs to automatically audit local language Wikipedia repositories (such as Hindi or regional Indian languages) against global scientific articles to identify critical knowledge gaps and draft stub articles.
ideas.problem_statement: Open-source AI solutions for real-world public-good challenges in collaboration with WikiClub Tech.
ideas.title: WikiClub Multilingual Knowledge Gaps Identifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to WikiClub Tech as a partner organization by directly solving digital inclusion and language equity on Wikipedia.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, offline-first multimodal AI tutor designed for low-bandwidth rural Indian classrooms that converts textbook photos into interactive, vernacular voice-guided Q&A.
ideas.problem_statement: Building open-source AI solutions for real-world public-good challenges under academic research institution guidance.
ideas.title: Rural Education Open-Source Multimodal Tutor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features concrete social impact with measurable reach for rural education, satisfying judges looking for practical implementation in developing regions.

ideas.pitch: An open-source NLP pipeline that ingests citizen infrastructure complaints from multiple municipal channels, categorizes urgency using fine-tuned open-weight models, and auto-routes them to appropriate civic departments.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world public-good challenge focusing on practical implementation and social impact.
ideas.title: CivicFlow Open-Source Grievance Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear municipal utility and open-source reusability, echoing patterns from winning civic tech hacks.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI diagnostic tool built on open-source computer vision models that allows farmers to scan crop leaves offline and instantly receive localized treatment protocols in regional dialects.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world public-good challenges addressing agricultural sustainability and rural livelihoods.
ideas.title: AgriOpenAI Crop Disease Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses agrarian economic stability with a working computer vision demo, a proven winner at research-backed hackathons.
